meta.prompt: Build a small checkout in three steps: my cart (three items with quantities), a shipping form (name, address, city, postcode, email, all checked, with messages under the fields), then a payment summary with a choice of standard or express delivery changing the total, and a confirmation screen with an order number. I can go back a step without losing what I typed.
meta.text:
Line 75 was the "Continue to payment" button, where I wrote visible:= as if it were a node. Visibility belongs as a prop on the button, but the notation says a node must be a catalog type, so I'll drop the bogus line and guard the button with an if instead. I'll also simplify the template expressions so they stay within the notation.

Column gap:12 pad:16 w:390
  state step=1
  state name=""
  state address=""
  state city=""
  state postcode=""
  state email=""
  state delivery="standard"
  state qty1=1
  state qty2=2
  state qty3=1
  state orderNo="ORD-20417"
  state errName=""
  state errAddress=""
  state errCity=""
  state errPostcode=""
  state errEmail=""
  Row between
    Text.title "Checkout"
    Text.muted "Step {step} of 3"
  if step==1
    Card gap:12
      Text.heading "My cart"
      Row between
        Column gap:2
          Text.strong "Espresso beans, 1 kg"
          Text.muted "\$24.00 each"
        Row gap:8
          IconButton "minus" -> qty1=max(1,qty1-1)
          Text.strong "{qty1}"
          IconButton "plus" -> qty1=qty1+1
      Row between
        Column gap:2
          Text.strong "Ceramic dripper"
          Text.muted "\$18.00 each"
        Row gap:8
          IconButton "minus" -> qty2=max(1,qty2-1)
          Text.strong "{qty2}"
          IconButton "plus" -> qty2=qty2+1
      Row between
        Column gap:2
          Text.strong "Paper filters (100)"
          Text.muted "\$6.00 each"
        Row gap:8
          IconButton "minus" -> qty3=max(1,qty3-1)
          Text.strong "{qty3}"
          IconButton "plus" -> qty3=qty3+1
      Divider
      Row between
        Text.strong "Subtotal"
        Text.strong "\$\{24*qty1+18*qty2+6*qty3\}"
      Button "Continue to shipping" -> step=2

  if step==2
    Card gap:10
      Text.heading "Shipping details"
      Input "Full name" =name -> errName=name==""?"Name is required":""
      if errName!=""
        Text.danger "{errName}"
      Input "Address" =address -> errAddress=address==""?"Address is required":""
      if errAddress!=""
        Text.danger "{errAddress}"
      Input "City" =city -> errCity=city==""?"City is required":""
      if errCity!=""
        Text.danger "{errCity}"
      Input "Postcode" =postcode -> errPostcode=postcode==""?"Postcode is required":""
      if errPostcode!=""
        Text.danger "{errPostcode}"
      Input "Email" "you@example.com" =email -> errEmail=email.includes("@")?"":"Enter a valid email"
      if errEmail!=""
        Text.danger "{errEmail}"
      Row between
        Button.ghost "Back" -> step=1
        if name!=""&&address!=""&&city!=""&&postcode!=""&&email.includes("@")
          Button "Continue to payment" -> step=3

  if step==3
    Card gap:12
      Text.heading "Payment summary"
      Text.muted "Shipping to {name}, {address}, {city} {postcode}"
      Select =delivery items:["standard","express"]
      Row between
        Text.body "Items"
        Text.body "\$\{24*qty1+18*qty2+6*qty3\}"
      Row between
        Text.body "Delivery"
        Text.body "\$\{delivery=='express'?12:4\}"
      Divider
      Row between
        Text.strong "Total"
        Text.strong "\$\{24*qty1+18*qty2+6*qty3+(delivery=='express'?12:4)\}"
      Row between
        Button.ghost "Back" -> step=2
        Button "Place order" -> step=4; emit placeOrder

  if step==4
    Card gap:10
      Icon "check-circle"
      Text.title "Thank you for your order"
      Text.body "Your order number is {orderNo}."
      Text.muted "A confirmation has been sent to {email}."
      Button "Back to start" -> step=1
